events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Maria Alvarez here. Date of birth, 03/14/1968. Could I get more of my albuterol inhaler?
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, albuterol inhaler, two puffs every four to six hours when needed, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Your request reference is R Q, three three two nine. It is awaiting prescribing team review, and they will call or text you with the outcome.
